COURSE.Definition: the direction in which something develops; the passing of a period of time

RUN UP.Definition: the period of time just before an important event

AFTERMATH.Definition: the period after a terrible event and the effects it had

THEORISED.Definition: developed ideas without being able to prove them

SPLIT.Definition: broken into separate parts; also: break into separate parts

NUCLEAR FISSION.Definition: a process in which the centre of an atom breaks apart, releasing energy

FRINGE.Definition: outside the main group and not taken seriously

PERSECUTION.Definition: cruel and unfair treatment, especially because of race or religion

IN EXILE.Definition: living away from his own country because it was not safe there

CHAIN REACTION.Definition: a process in which each step causes the next, so it continues by itself

FUNDING.Definition: money given for a particular purpose

ENRICHED.Definition: processed to increase the amount of a particular useful type in it

ISOTOPE.Definition: a form of a chemical element whose atoms have a different number of neutrons

ISOLATED.Definition: far away from other places and people

OBITUARIES.Definition: articles about people's lives, written after they die

MUSHROOM CLOUD.Definition: a huge cloud of smoke with a wide round top, formed after a very big explosion

MELTED.Definition: turned into liquid because of the heat

IN AWE OF.Definition: filled with amazement, respect and some fear at

DETONATION.Definition: the explosion that was set off on purpose

INEVITABLE.Definition: certain to happen; impossible to avoid
